about.heroSubtitle: We believe every business trip deserves to feel like home
about.storyOrigin: StayNeos was born from a simple observation: in Toronto, business professionals faced a dilemma — hotels were cramped and impersonal; traditional rentals were complicated and inflexible. We decided to change that.
about.storyMission: In 2024, we founded StayNeos to create premium executive apartments designed for business professionals. Every property is carefully selected and fully equipped with furniture and workspaces, so our guests can focus on what matters from day one.
about.storyToday: Today, StayNeos has become Toronto's leading executive apartment platform, serving business professionals and corporate clients across tech, finance, healthcare, and beyond. We don't just provide accommodation — we provide a lifestyle of effortless comfort.
about.peopleFirstDesc: Every guest is a person, not a booking number. We pay attention to details — from welcome gifts to 24/7 support — so every stay feels valued
about.qualityDesc: We personally inspect every property to ensure furniture, amenities, and locations meet executive standards. If it's not great, it doesn't make the cut
about.flexibilityDesc: The business world changes fast, and housing should adapt. From one week to one year, we offer truly flexible terms without red tape
about.sustainabilityDesc: We prioritize eco-friendly buildings, reduce single-use items, and partner with sustainability-minded landlords. For professionals, and for the planet
